messages:
Ravi: Quick sync 5 we saw a spike in fncall validation rejects during the integration canary. They look like small formatting issues but all surface as hard rejects. Need to separate hard vs permissive/soft in metrics and explain billing.
Elena: Can you share an example payload?
Ravi: extra top-level `trace_meta` field from partner A. Strict validator treats it as unknown property -> reject. Partner expects permissive behavior.
Tess: Two-pronged ask: 1) Emit coarse metric labels only (ok/soft/hard) to avoid Prom cardinality. 2) Make sampled raw events searchable with a stable reason_id so SREs can debug.
Marco: Agreed. Implementation: exporter emits `fncall_validation_total{outcome="soft"}` etc. Detailed reason goes to event log with `reason_id=sha1(...)` and `sample_id`.
Elena: Sampling: partner A is 80% of traffic so uniform sampling misses rare customers. We should stratify by customer_id with a small reservoir floor for low-volume accounts.
Tess: Yep. Proposed sampler: stratified reservoir per customer_id with min_slots=10/day and default=1000/hour for heavy customers. Config per-route flag.
Ravi: UX: dashboard panel should show three series (ok/soft/hard) + a stacked bar for soft_degraded_tokens. Also heatmap top (route,outcome) with sample-rate overlay. Toggle canary vs prod.
Marco: Metric caution: don't add integration_id as a Prom label. Use it only in traces/events. Prom labels remain low-cardinality.
Elena: Billing: product wants soft_degraded token meter. We'll emit `usage.billing_category=soft_degraded` on usage events. Need billing team signoff.
Tess: Rollout plan: 24h permissive canary with only coarse metrics and sampling. Then enable strictness for 1% traffic and ramp to 25/50 if hard_rate < 0.2% for 30m. Auto-rollback if hard_rate > 0.5% for 10m.
flag-bot: Flag-runner supports metric-driven rollback via webhook. Suggested alert rule: when rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="hard"}[10m]) / rate(fncall_validation_total[10m]) > 0.005 -> call rollback API.
Ravi: Add audit annotation to rollbacks so we can trace. Also add dashboard annotation when flag flips.
Marco: Owners: Marco -> exporter change (coarse label) + billing tag. Tess -> sampler & stratify. Elena -> dashboard + annotations. Ravi -> coordinate canary + customer comms.
docs-bot: Created doc stub: https://internal.docs/redwood/ops/fncall-metrics-sampling  please review and add runbook text.
Elena: One more: include a small example for `reason_id` generation in logs, e.g., `reason_id=sha256("unknown_property:trace_meta")` so SREs can search.
Tess: We'll also add `sample_id` to events for correlation with metrics spikes.
Ravi: Thanks team. I'll hold the canary start until exporter PR merges. Please ping when reviewer approves.
